english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an abstract possibility or possible prospect.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for whether something is likely or probable.
This is the all-purpose noun for the possibility or likelihood of an outcome, without the opportunity meaning of 機會.
Use this instead of 機會 when chance means an abstract likelihood or possibility rather than an opportunity.

examples.english: The possibility of this plan succeeding isn't low.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃成功嘅可能性唔低。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sing4 gung1 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 m4 dai1
